Usage: gaia extract submit [OPTIONS] PDF

 Submit a local PDF for LKM knowledge extraction (POST /parse/task).

╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *    pdf      PATH  Local PDF to extract (max 64 MiB). [required]            │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --index,--server        TEXT   Configured LKM index id. [default: bohrium]   │
│ --wait                         Poll until the task reaches a terminal state. │
│ --poll-interval         FLOAT  Seconds between polls when --wait is set; the │
│                                5s default matches the service.               │
│                                [default: 5.0]                                │
│ --timeout               FLOAT  Seconds to wait before giving up when --wait  │
│                                is set.                                       │
│                                [default: 1800.0]                             │
│ --out                   PATH   Write JSON to PATH (atomic) instead of        │
│                                stdout.                                       │
│ --no-hint                      Suppress Gaia follow-up suggestions on        │
│                                stderr.                                       │
│ --help                         Show this message and exit.                   │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

 Use this when you hold a PDF that may not be in the LKM corpus yet.
 Resubmitting the same PDF reuses the existing extraction rather than starting
 over, so an already-processed PDF comes back terminal immediately with
 `cache_hit`. `cache_source` says where that reuse came from: `lkm` when the
 paper was already extracted in the corpus, `local` when an earlier submission
 of this same PDF produced it. Resubmitting will not hurry a running task
 along; it only mints extra task ids that share the same progress and result.
 Without --wait the task id is all you get; poll it with `gaia extract status`.
 API docs: https://s.apifox.cn/<UUID4>
